ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the food chain diagram, what happens to the raccoon population if the fish population decreases?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-chain diagram shows the label “Fish” below the label “Raccoons,” with an arrow pointing from Fish up toward Raccoons. Reasoning: In a food chain, arrows show energy or food moving from the food source to the consumer. So raccoons depend on fish as a food source. If the fish population decreases, raccoons have less available food, so the raccoon population decreases.
